benchmark.methodology: Alternating variant order; same layout call; independent primed baselines; packing cost included in cold layout and changed-paragraph edits; no drawing or startup. Glyph packing adds a view alongside shaped clusters; caret packing instead replaces caret objects and offset maps. The shaping variant replaces retained shaped objects with packed columns and uses packed carets in both comparison arms.
